description.description: Informational. Text describing what the gadget does or who/where it is attributed to.

links.description: Informational. Lists the links the gadget is attributed to/sourced from.

code.description: Lists the script, stylesheet, Vue component, and JSON files to be loaded as one gadget.

enabled.description: If set to true, compile this gadget as part of the bundle output, regardless of workspace settings.

disabled.description: If set to true, do not compile this gadget as part of the bundle output.

resourceLoader.description: Sets various conditions for ResourceLoader. [See Extension:Gadgets for more information.](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Gadgets)

default.description: Sets the gadget to be on by default.

hidden.description: Sets the gadget to be hidden on Special:Preferences

package.description: Sets the components of the gadget to be compiled as various files in one package. Required to be set to true if using .vue or .json files.

dependencies.description: Sets other ResourceLoader modules to be loaded as dependencies that will be loaded before this gadget is loaded.

rights.description: User rights that are required to load the module.

skins.description: Skins on which the module may be loaded.

actions.description: Page actions on which the module may be loaded.

categories.description: Categories on which the module may be loaded.

namespaces.description: Numeric namespace IDs for which the module may be loaded.

contentModels.description: Page content models on which the module may be loaded.

peers.description: A list of CSS-only gadgets to be loaded together with your gadget.

codexIcons.description: List of Codex icons to be loaded onto an icons.json file in the package. Refer to [Wikimedia's Codex guide for a list of all icons](https://doc.wikimedia.org/codex/main/icons/all-icons.html).

supportsUrlLoad.description: Set as true to support loading the module when ?withgadget is set as a query parameter.
